registration_precondition: Registered before any revision variable was constructed and before any revision-outcome relationship was inspected on development data.
tested_relationship: Whether the 5h-to-1h renewable forecast revision for a DK1 delivery hour carries information about that same hour's realized balancing-pressure outcome: the frozen label (UP / DOWN / NEUTRAL, delta 5.9956075 EUR/MWh, D026) and the frozen continuous signed spread.

revision_variable.same_hour_rule: Both horizon fields must be non-null in the same HourUTC + PriceArea + ForecastType row (D021).
revision_variable.wind_aggregate: wind_revision_t = revision_OffshoreWind_t + revision_OnshoreWind_t, computed only when all four wind horizon fields are non-null.
revision_variable.secondary_scale: wind_revision_t / wind_forecast_5h_t, reported only where wind_forecast_5h_t is at or above a development-distribution floor fixed in P4.2 (avoids divide-by-near-zero).

primary_wind.role: This test alone determines whether H2 is supported.
primary_wind.rationale: DK1 has a very high wind share; wind is the dominant renewable driver of physical imbalance.

secondary_solar.procedure: identical full procedure (buckets, association, rule, chart, baselines) with its own separate success/failure judgment
secondary_solar.labelling_rule: A solar-only positive result is reported as 'conditionally supported - solar only, needs replication', never as 'H2 supported'.

expected_direction.mechanism: A positive wind revision means more wind is expected as delivery approaches, implying a looser expected balance and a higher probability the hour settles as DOWN pressure (balancing price below the already-cleared day-ahead). A negative revision implies the reverse and favours UP.
predictions_on_development_data: P(DOWN | wind_revision in the top bucket) > P(DOWN | wind_revision in the middle bucket)
P(UP | wind_revision in the bottom bucket) > P(UP | wind_revision in the middle bucket)
A directionally consistent gradient in DOWN-share minus UP-share across ordered revision buckets.
A negative rank association between signed wind_revision_t and the signed spread.
admissible_results: conditionally supported - solar only, needs replication

buckets.primary_scheme: five ordered groups by development-only signed quantiles Q20 / Q40 / Q60 / Q80
buckets.secondary_scheme: ten-group signed-decile view, in case the relationship is concentrated in the tails
buckets.strong_revision_threshold_round_1: none; the quantile grid is used instead of a hand-picked magnitude cutoff (magnitude-threshold tuning is I07 / P4.4 / P7)

test_method_round_1: Contingency table: revision bucket by frozen label, with row and column shares and group sizes (five-quantile primary, ten-decile secondary).
Primary rank association: Spearman correlation between signed wind_revision_t and the frozen continuous signed spread (EUR/MWh), with a bootstrap confidence interval on development data.
Secondary rank association: Spearman between signed wind_revision_t and the ordinal label score (+1 UP, 0 NEUTRAL, -1 DOWN).

Transparent rule: predict DOWN if wind_revision_t > c, UP if wind_revision_t < -c, else NEUTRAL; c fixed at the frozen development Q60 revision magnitude (pre-registered, not tuned); scored on three-class balanced accuracy and macro-F1.
One chart: DOWN / UP / NEUTRAL share by revision bucket (also satisfies the Level A meaningful-chart criterion).

computed_and_reported: majority class fit on training labels only
persistence y_hat_t = y_(t-1), retained as an ex-post reference
baselines.pass_fail_gate: only the two availability-safe baselines (majority and hour-of-week)
baselines.persistence_handling: ex_post_reference_only and decision_feature_eligible false (D023, E001); cannot be proven available at the decision cutoff, so it is not a pass/fail gate. Reported prominently: if the rule does not beat persistence, the write-up says so and defers 'does the revision add information beyond lagged state' to the P10 multivariate stage.

primary_wind_supported_requires_all: the DOWN-minus-UP share gradient is monotone in the predicted direction across at least four of the five quantile buckets
the primary Spearman interval excludes zero with the predicted (negative) sign
the transparent rule beats both availability-safe baselines (majority and hour-of-week) on both balanced accuracy and macro-F1 (with the in-sample delta caveat, E002)
success_and_failure_criterion.conditionally_supported_if: the gradient and association hold but the rule does not beat the two availability-safe baselines; mechanism evidence is reported and no edge is claimed
success_and_failure_criterion.rejected_null_if: neither the gradient/association nor the rule holds; a valid completed test (D013, D017), retained in full
success_and_failure_criterion.solar_secondary: identical bar, judged separately; a solar-only pass is 'conditionally supported - solar only, needs replication'

counterargument: The day-ahead and intraday markets may already absorb the forecast update, so by delivery the balancing outcome could be driven more by outages, cross-border flows and demand surprises than by the renewable revision. A raw association may also reflect season or regime confounding.
invalidation: If conditioning on season, hour-of-day regime or cross-border capacity (H3 / P6) removes the gradient, H2 is at best conditional.

If P4.2 diagnostics show the 5h and 1h values are not independent pre-delivery observations (for example a large share of hours where Forecast5Hour equals Forecast1Hour exactly), the revision variable's information content is reinterpreted or the test is paused.
p4_2_diagnostics_before_outcome_comparis: Share of eligible hours where Forecast5Hour == Forecast1Hour exactly, and the mass within a small +/- epsilon band
Coverage: hours with a non-null wind_revision_t, hours dropped for missing horizons, per forecast type
The frozen five-quantile and ten-decile bucket edges and group sizes
denominators_to_disclose: hours with a valid frozen label (21,886)
deferred_to_p4_4: regime conditioning (tight / normal / loose, renewable level)

frozen_inputs_not_reopened_here.target_labels_and_spread: D026 (UP / DOWN / NEUTRAL, delta 5.9956075 EUR/MWh; continuous signed spread)
frozen_inputs_not_reopened_here.forecast_field_handling: D020 / D021 (fixed-horizon snapshots; non-null same-hour pairs only; no zero-fill; preserve zeros and negatives; DST rules)
